scenes.title: MEET THE SOLAR PANEL
scenes.subtitle: A rooftop can collect sunlight.
scenes.narration: Sunlight carries energy. Solar panels capture it without burning fuel, turning rooftops into small power stations.

scenes.title: ENERGY ON THE MOVE
scenes.subtitle: From the Sun to an electrical circuit.
scenes.narration: Inside each panel, light frees electrons in semiconductor cells, creating electric current that moves through wiring.

scenes.title: USE IT OR SAVE IT
scenes.subtitle: Control and store the current.
scenes.narration: An inverter makes the electricity usable at home. Batteries can store some energy for later.

scenes.title: TURN ON THE LIGHT
scenes.subtitle: Electricity changes into illumination.
scenes.narration: Switch on a lamp, and electrical energy becomes light, with some also released as heat.

scenes.title: ONE CONNECTED STORY
scenes.subtitle: Energy is transformed, not created.
scenes.narration: From sunlight through panels, wires, and storage to a bright room, energy keeps changing form.
